ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark/black) background with approximately 5-10% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and scattered as micro-points across the surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base dark pigmentation across >90% of surface area; high-contrast contiguous white clusters at the distal apex of both the left and right lobes; stochastic distribution of small white circular spots (2-5 pixel diameter) across the mid-ventral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 60-65 degrees and a depth ratio of approximately 1:6 relative to the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing margin; right lobe trailing edge exhibits deeper, more frequent sawtooth-like peaks and valleys (5-12 pixel displacement) compared to the left lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges transitioning to distal tips; trailing edges follow a shallow concave sweep toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed white pixel clusters at both distal tips with a textured, irregular circular topography; multiple isolated white circular clusters (0.5% surface area) scattered across the lower-medial fluke region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, vertically-oriented high-intensity linear streaks (rake-like marks) visible on the right lobe and the central region near the peduncle attachment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured white encrustations/scarring localized at the tips of both lobes; visible physical irregularity in the serration of the right inner trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical jaggedness of the trailing edge, where the right inner lobe margin displays a significantly more eroded pixel profile than the left inner lobe margin.
